PHOTO & PRINT TOOLS

Passport Photo Maker

Crop passport, visa and application photos, collect different images and sizes, and arrange copies on ready-to-print sheets. Everything stays in your browser.

Choose the size required by your application. 2 × 2 inch is a common US passport size; 35 × 45 mm is used for UK passports and many visa applications. For India or any other country, visa, exam or studio order, use Custom size and enter the dimensions on your form. Dimensions alone do not guarantee acceptance. Check the issuing authority’s current rules for background, head position, lighting and digital file requirements. This tool does not certify photos. Follow your application’s background rules when changing colours. US passport photo rules · UK passport photo rules

1. Collect photos

JPG, PNG, WebP and browser-supported images. Up to 20 photos; 25 MB / 40 megapixels each.

2. Crop & size each photo

Add a photo to start. Select each photo to adjust its own size, crop and copies.

3. Arrange & download

For exact physical sizes, print the PDF at 100% / Actual size. Turn off Fit to page. Sheet images are sized at 300 DPI; set the selected paper dimensions in your print software.

Private by design. No photo uploads to a server.
